# EFIMS AI — Runtime dependencies to run the API
# Install with: pip install -r requirements.txt
#
# This list was generated by actually running the API (every endpoint, via
# TestClient, with the real model_registry/ artifacts) and recording every
# third-party package that got imported — not by hand-guessing from source.
# Versions are exactly what venv/ has installed today (`pip freeze`).
#
# Verified by installing ONLY this file into a brand-new venv and running
# the real `uvicorn` server against it (not just the test suite, which has
# its own unrelated dependency — see the httpx note below): /api/v1/health
# reported all three models loaded, and a real severity prediction returned
# a correct 200 response.
#
# Only directly-imported, runtime-required packages are pinned here; each
# one's own sub-dependencies (starlette, scipy, click, h11, ...) are resolved
# automatically by pip and are intentionally NOT pinned individually.
#
# NOT included, and NOT needed to run the API:
#   httpx             — only used by FastAPI's TestClient in test_phase*.py;
#                       a real `uvicorn` server never imports it.
#   python-dotenv,
#   pydantic-settings — not imported anywhere in src/ today.
#   xgboost, spacy    — listed in early config drafts but never actually
#                       imported; the NLP/duplicate models that would need
#                       them haven't been built yet (see README limitations).

# API server
fastapi==0.162.0
uvicorn==0.54.0
python-multipart==0.0.32
pydantic==2.14.1

# Config / data
pyyaml==6.0.3
pandas==3.1.0
numpy==2.5.4
# pandas 3.x does NOT list pyarrow as a mandatory dependency, but silently
# changes its default string dtype behaviour when pyarrow IS present (which
# is the behaviour this project's cleaning/feature code was built and
# tested against). Pin it explicitly or pandas will quietly behave
# differently on a fresh install.
pyarrow==25.0.1

# Model inference (unpickling + predicting with the saved model_registry/*.pkl files)
scikit-learn==1.9.1
lightgbm==4.7.0
joblib==1.6.0
shap==0.54.1

# mlflow is NOT listed here. It used to be required even at inference time,
# because src/models/*/trainer.py did `import mlflow` at module level, and
# joblib.load() on a saved model re-imports that trainer module to
# reconstruct the pickled class. That import was moved inside the one
# function that actually calls mlflow (_log_to_mlflow, training-time only);
# verified this session by blocking mlflow from being importable at all
# (sys.modules["mlflow"] = None) and confirming the full API still starts
# and predicts correctly. Install mlflow==3.17.2 separately only if you need
# to re-run training (see README's "Running training" section).
